findings.title: Grouping on a display name merges different customers
findings.evidence: GROUP BY uses grouping column values; display names are not unique customer identities.
findings.recommendation: Include CustomerId and add executable original same-name and join-grain examples.
findings.resolution: Include CustomerId and add executable original same-name and join-grain examples.

findings.title: Integrity and query performance are distinct
findings.evidence: Foreign keys enforce references but do not automatically create indexes.
findings.recommendation: Explain constraints and add a rejected-reference exercise.
findings.resolution: Explain constraints and add a rejected-reference exercise.

findings.title: Container throughput can be dedicated or database-shared
findings.evidence: Database shared RU/s is not a separate allocation for each container.
findings.recommendation: Qualify the scale-boundary paragraph and add work/rate reasoning.
findings.resolution: Qualify the scale-boundary paragraph and add work/rate reasoning.

findings.title: Only the MongoDB vCore product was renamed
findings.evidence: November 18, 2025 notice identifies the former vCore offering.
findings.recommendation: Separate Azure DocumentDB from native Cosmos APIs and RU MongoDB.
findings.resolution: Separate Azure DocumentDB from native Cosmos APIs and RU MongoDB.

findings.title: PostgreSQL product is on a retirement path
findings.evidence: Primary notice recommends different current services and gives no final retirement date.
findings.recommendation: Add scope and new-project guidance without inventing a deadline.
findings.resolution: Add scope and new-project guidance without inventing a deadline.

findings.title: Query predicates do not make a query a point read
findings.evidence: The dedicated operation uses ID and partition key; RU cost depends on size and consistency.
findings.recommendation: Add operation distinction and bounded worked RU example.
findings.resolution: Add operation distinction and bounded worked RU example.

findings.title: Real-time service recognition needs concrete roles
findings.evidence: Eventstream ingests/transforms/routes; separate stores and rules evaluate downstream.
findings.recommendation: Map Eventstream, Eventhouse, Activator and Spark processing to different jobs.
findings.resolution: Map Eventstream, Eventhouse, Activator and Spark processing to different jobs.

findings.title: Read-only table data still permits SQL objects
findings.evidence: Lakehouse endpoint cannot DML-write Delta data but supports SQL views/functions/procedures.
findings.recommendation: Add write-path and access-path security distinctions.
findings.resolution: Add write-path and access-path security distinctions.

findings.title: References and replication have different behavior
findings.evidence: Shortcuts reference targets with identity checks; supported external caching keeps local data.
findings.recommendation: Compare shortcuts with mirroring without a zero-cache or backup guarantee.
findings.resolution: Compare shortcuts with mirroring without a zero-cache or backup guarantee.

findings.title: Older Fabric labs can expect a model that is no longer created
findings.evidence: Automatic creation ended September 5, 2025; existing defaults decoupled by November 30.
findings.recommendation: Require explicit semantic-model creation and dependency review.
findings.resolution: Require explicit semantic-model creation and dependency review.

findings.title: Measure correctness depends on grain and aggregation
findings.evidence: Facts need consistent grain; explicit measures evaluate in query context.
findings.recommendation: Add weighted margin and freshness diagnosis exercises.
findings.resolution: Add weighted margin and freshness diagnosis exercises.
